questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT a description of compounds?

options.A: They can exist in the form of atoms or molecules.
options.B: They consist of atoms of two or more elements bonded together.
options.C: They have properties that are different from their component elements.
options.D: They can be broken down into elements by chemical means but not physical means.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - They can exist in the form of atoms or molecules.

questions.stem_text: In a copper wire, a temperature increase is the result of which of the following?

options.A: an increase in the size of the copper particles
options.B: a decrease in the mass of the copper particles
options.C: an increase in the motion of the copper particles
options.D: a decrease in the distance between the copper particles

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - an increase in the motion of the copper particles
